neighbours.label: when a multi-digit number that already appeared earlier in the text is written out again, on the digit just before a 6 in the copy (numerals only; a fresh number, a famous one like 666, a copied number with no 6, or the word 'six' stay silent)
neighbours.short: copying an earlier number, just before its 6
neighbours.notes: Card: + pole promotes '6'/'six'; top examples peak on the token before a copied 6. Feeders first: strongest late feeder L33/N737+ is a copied-digit cell; early feeders L10/N4531+, L8/N8454- look topical. Probes: repeated numbers with an inner 6 fired 0.2-1.07; same copies with 7 instead of 6 ~0; fresh 6s, 666, Route 66, pi, 'six' ~0; a 6 that opens the copied number was weaker (0.17). Blind test written from the label only by a second author.
